stories.headline: Thailand is experiencing a notable surge in foreign investment, with inflows topping 154 billion baht in the first five months of the year, representing a 73% i
stories.summary: Thailand has seen a significant surge in foreign investment, with inflows reaching 154 billion baht in the first five months of 2026. This represents a 73% increase from the same period last year. The country's foreign investment has been steadily rising, with the first quarter of 2026 alone seeing 97.78 billion baht in investment, up from 47.03 billion baht in the same period in 2025. In 2025, foreign direct investment in Thailand surged by 125% to over 225.5 billion baht in the first eight months, led by companies from Japan, Singapore, and others. The Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) has been a major recipient of this investment, accounting for 54% of all foreign direct investment in the first five months of 2025. The investment boom continues to drive economic growth in Thailand.

stories.headline: Donald Trump warns the Iranian delegation they might not return home from talks in Switzerland talks as the US and Iran argue over the fate of the Strait of Hor
stories.summary: The US and Iran are engaged in high-stakes talks in Switzerland to finalize a deal to end the war. However, the negotiations got off to a difficult start, with Iranian negotiators walking out in protest over insults from US President Donald Trump. Trump warned Iranian officials that if they close the Strait of Hormuz, "you won't have a country." He also allegedly told them that if the strait is shut again, they "wouldn't make it back to their country." The US president threatened Iran with fresh strikes and control of the Strait of Hormuz, deepening tensions around Lebanon, shipping restrictions, and Tehran's refusal to widen its cooperation. The talks are expected to continue through the week despite the tense start. Trump's comments have escalated the situation, with the Iranian delegation facing warnings about their safety.

stories.headline: Europe is facing years of maximum danger. In an era of reduced US engagement, strengthening deterrence against Russia requires strengthening three interlocking
stories.summary: Europe faces years of maximum danger due to reduced US engagement, requiring strengthened deterrence against Russia. This involves bolstering three interlocking foundations: resources, readiness, and resolve. As NATO allies balance key aims, they must cooperate deeply to craft a coherent strategy for confronting new threats. The Russian threat persists, and Europeans need a distinctly European model of defense. Putin seeks concessions from NATO, and the factors deterring Russia from an attack - the war in Ukraine, military capacity, and NATO strength - are under strain. The conventional and nuclear capabilities of the US and Russia have changed since the Cold War, but the logic of credible deterrence and escalation dominance in Europe remains. NATO's deterrence against Russia is under pressure, and Europeans must adapt to defend themselves without relying solely on America's help. A new strategy is necessary to address the ongoing threat.

stories.headline: According to preliminary results from Sunday's second round published by the national electoral authority, far-right candidate Abelardo de la Espriella is Colom
stories.summary: Abelardo de la Espriella, a far-right candidate, has won Colombia's presidential runoff election, according to preliminary results from the national electoral authority. De la Espriella, associated with the Defenders of the Homeland movement, led the second round and is set to become Colombia's next president for the 2026-2030 term. He defeated leftwing senator Iván Cepeda, with voters backing his promises of a crackdown on crime and a stronger economy. De la Espriella, a millionaire lawyer and self-styled "outsider," has been endorsed by former US President Donald Trump. His victory marks a sharp turn to the right in Colombian politics, with potential implications for the country's security, economy, and peace policies. The National Civil Registry released the preliminary results, indicating a significant shift in the country's political landscape.

stories.headline: Brawl Stars and adidas Launch a Tournament, a Capsule Collection, and a Pop-Up - and It's the Game's First-Ever Apparel Skin Collab
stories.summary: Brawl Stars and adidas have launched a multi-phase partnership, featuring a full in-game tournament, the adidas Starr Cup, where players build and compete with their own Brawl Ball teams. The partnership also includes multiple apparel and footwear collections for juniors, set to be released on August 1, 2026, via adidas and select retailers online. A live activation will take place at the adidas Home of Soccer fan event. Additionally, a pop-up event will be held, marking the game's first-ever apparel skin collaboration. The collections will offer a range of footwear and clothing items, available online and through select retailers. This partnership brings together the worlds of gaming and sports, offering a unique experience for Brawl Stars players and adidas fans. The in-game event and apparel collections are expected to generate significant excitement among fans.

stories.headline: I fed the 829-page Mercedes G-Class manual to Claude and found 3 hidden features
stories.summary: The 2026 Mercedes G-Class AMG has been unveiled, boasting 680 horsepower. The vehicle features a nine-speed automatic and two-speed transfer case, powering all four wheels. The G-Class lineup includes the AMG G 63 with a 4.0-liter biturbo V8, producing 577 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. A fully electric G 580 with EQ technology is also available. Additionally, a test was conducted where an 829-page Mercedes G-Class manual was fed to an AI system called Claude, revealing three hidden features. The test demonstrated Claude's capabilities, which will be integrated into systems used by banks, airlines, and other regulated industries through DXC's Claude Corps initiative. This technology has the potential to streamline information organization and research processes.

stories.headline: Kia EOFY drive-away deals 2026: full pricing on EV3, EV4 and EV5 range
stories.summary: Kia is offering drive-away pricing on six EV variants through June 2026, with prices starting at $46,990 for the EV3 Air SR and topping out at $62,990 for the EV4 Earth. The Kia EV3 Air SR is available for $46,990 drive-away, while the entry-level Kia EV5 Air Standard Range is priced at $49,990 drive-away, or $50,990 in Western Australia, to clear 2025-built stock. The 2026 Kia EV4 sedan starts from $49,990 plus on-road costs and is available in three variants. Kia has also introduced drive-away pricing on its Stonic and Sorento hybrid models, with reduced prices compared to pre-offer pricing. The offers are available until the end of June 2026, unless extended, and provide customers with discounted pricing on various Kia models.

stories.headline: Amazon Drops the 4.8-Star Marshall Acton III to Its Record Low, 60W of Rock 'n' Roll Sound
stories.summary: The Marshall Acton III Bluetooth Home Speaker has dropped to its record low price on Amazon, now available for $179, down from its usual $299. This represents a 40% discount. The speaker boasts a 4.8-star rating across over 2,300 reviews and features 60W of output, delivering a wide, full stereo soundstage. Its two-way driver system pairs to produce powerful sound, despite being the smallest member of Marshall's home speaker lineup. The discounted price applies to the black and cream color options, offering a significant opportunity to purchase a high-rated wireless home speaker below its usual price point. This limited-time promotion brings high-class sound to homes at an affordable price, available on Amazon for Black Friday.

stories.headline: Christian Lundgaard wins IndyCar thriller at Road America The Arrow McLaren driver recovered from first-lap damage before Marcus Armstrong lost the lead late
stories.summary: Christian Lundgaard won the XPEL Grand Prix at Road America, overcoming a broken front wing on the opening lap. The Arrow McLaren driver started 13th and was forced to pit after contact with Scott Dixon damaged his left-front wing. Despite the early setback, Lundgaard recovered to take the lead after Marcus Armstrong lost the top spot late in the race. Lundgaard held off David Malukas to secure the victory, expressing surprise over the radio, asking his team "How did we do that?" The 24-year-old Danish driver is in his fifth year in IndyCar and second with Arrow McLaren Chevrolet. The win marked a chaotic end to the race, with Lundgaard emerging as the unexpected winner after a dramatic turn of events at Road America.

stories.headline: Revolutionary Guard claim is ‘outright lie’, says Iran’s football federation The US claimed someone tied to the IRGC, under the guise of the Iranian federation chief, tried to board Iran’s team flight to Los Angeles.
stories.summary: The Iranian football federation has denied US claims that an individual tied to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) attempted to board the Iran team's flight to Los Angeles. The federation called the claim an "outright lie" and "baseless allegations." The US had accepted 53 people from Iran's team, despite most teams traveling with around 120 people. Visas were issued to all players and necessary support staff on Friday, 10 days before Iran's opening fixture in Los Angeles on June 15. The team has been training in Mexico and will play in the US, marking the first time a host nation will receive a team from a country it is at war with. The Iranian federation criticized the US for spreading "false statements and misinformation" to justify restrictions on the team's delegation.

stories.headline: Tottenham holding fresh talks to sign Sandro Tonali, learn price Tottenham are keen to wrap up a deal for Sandro Tonali at the earliest, as talks continue amid negotiations with Newcastle United to find an agreement
stories.summary: Tottenham are holding fresh talks to sign Newcastle United midfielder Sandro Tonali. The club is keen to wrap up a deal as soon as possible, with head coach Roberto De Zerbi pushing for a statement signing this summer. Tottenham has been in positive talks with Tonali's camp and has now engaged with Newcastle to find an agreement. Manchester City is also a contender to sign Tonali, with Arsenal and Italian clubs previously showing interest. Tottenham hopes a high salary offer will secure the deal. Tonali has been linked to several clubs, including Manchester City, who were seen as favorites to sign him in March. Tottenham faces competition, but the club is pushing to complete a deal for the midfielder. Negotiations are ongoing, with Tottenham aiming to finalize an agreement.

stories.headline: North Carolina vs. Oklahoma: Live updates, score for Men's College World Series Finals Game 2 Follow along here for live updates, score, highlights and more from Game 2 of the MCWS finals between North Carolina and Oklahoma.
stories.summary: North Carolina defeated Oklahoma 6-2 in Game 2 of the Men's College World Series finals, forcing a winner-take-all Game 3 on Monday. The UNC baseball team faced elimination on Father's Day but came back to secure the win. The game was part of the College World Series championship, with live score updates and highlights provided by USA TODAY Sports and The Fayetteville Observer/USA TODAY Network. The win sets up a decisive Game 3, where the winner will claim the championship title. Live scores, box scores, video highlights, and updated odds are available for every 2025-26 College Baseball season game on ESPN. The series will conclude with Game 3, determining the champion of the Men's College World Series.

stories.headline: India won't be mere buyer: PM Modi commissions 3 frontline ships
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commissioned three frontline ships, including two indigenous warships, to enhance India's naval power and maritime security. The tri-commissioning ceremony marked a milestone in the country's naval modernisation drive, coming 17 months after the simultaneous induction of three naval combatants in Mumbai. Modi emphasized that the new platforms symbolize India's commitment to indigenous design, manufacturing, and technological innovation. The addition of these advanced warships will integrate into the Navy's cohesive network, boosting its maritime warfare capabilities. The commissioning underscores India's shift towards self-reliance in defense manufacturing, with Modi stating that the country will not be a mere buyer, but rather a manufacturer of advanced defense technologies. This development is expected to strengthen India's naval presence and contribute to its overall defense capabilities.

stories.headline: Armed Nihangs storm Uttarakhand gurdwara, take manager hostage
stories.summary: A group of armed Nihangs stormed a gurdwara in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district, taking the manager hostage and vandalizing the premises. The Nihangs, armed with spears, swords, axes, and kirpans, climbed onto the roof with the manager. They are demanding the release of four sect members arrested after a clash in Chamoli on June 16. The group arrived from Mohali around 4 pm on Saturday, initially demanding arrangements for dozens of rooms for protesters. When their demands were not met, they allegedly took the manager hostage. The standoff continues, with the Nihangs refusing to back down until their demands are met. The situation remains tense, with authorities working to resolve the issue and secure the release of the hostage. The Nihangs' actions have caused concern and disruption at the gurdwara.

stories.headline: 12-year-old relative rapes nine-month-old girl in Gorakhpur, says 'he watched porn and was drunk'
stories.summary: A nine-month-old girl was allegedly abducted and raped by a 12-year-old relative in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. The incident occurred when the girl was sleeping next to her mother. The 12-year-old boy, who is the girl's maternal uncle, confessed to being drunk and watching porn before committing the crime. He took the baby away and assaulted her. The girl is currently fighting for her life in a medical facility and is reported to be stable. Police have confirmed the incident and are taking legal action. The case highlights the disturbing impact of early exposure to porn and alcohol on children's behavior and mental health. The accused is a minor, and the police are investigating the matter further. The girl's condition is being closely monitored, and authorities are working to ensure justice is served.

stories.headline: NEET UG re-test highlights: 9 fake candidates arrested in Bihar for allegedly impersonating students
stories.summary: Nine fake candidates were arrested in Bihar for allegedly impersonating students in the NEET UG re-test. The arrests were made in Lakhisarai, Bihar, as part of a crackdown on exam scams. Those arrested include an aspirant, his uncle, and two others. The CBI had earlier busted a mass rigging racket in the NEET-UG 2022 exam, arresting eight accused, including the mastermind and solvers who were impersonating on behalf of candidates. Additionally, the alleged mastermind of the NEET-UG paper leak, Sanjeev Mukhiya, was arrested in Bihar after an 11-month chase. He is accused of running interstate exam scams and receiving payments for NEET exam impersonation. The arrests highlight the ongoing efforts to prevent cheating and ensure the integrity of the NEET exam process.

stories.headline: FIFA’s Double Standard in Global Geopolitics The 2026 FIFA World Cup began surrounded by a contradiction that extends far beyond the boundaries of the football pitch
stories.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup has begun, featuring 48 teams and three host countries: Canada, Mexico, and the United States. This is the 23rd edition of the tournament and the first to have an expanded format with three host countries. FIFA has designed the match schedule based on technical analysis of venues, considering factors such as temperature, cooling infrastructure, public transport, and security. The tournament showcases a diverse range of player profiles, from Florian Wiegele, at 2.05 meters, to Panama's César Yanis, at 1.60 meters. Despite FIFA's efforts to present football as a neutral space, the tournament has been surrounded by geopolitical contradictions, highlighting the challenges of navigating global politics in international sports events. The tournament will proceed with its scheduled fixtures and results, available for viewing.

stories.headline: Insuring oil, shaping power: The hidden geopolitics of Middle East energy For decades, the geopolitics of Middle East energy has been defined by a familiar set of variables: oil reserves, production capacity, strategic waterways and m
stories.summary: The geopolitics of Middle East energy has shifted beyond traditional variables like oil reserves and military power. A new dynamic is emerging, with governments, oil majors, and independent producers investing billions to recover previously discovered oil. The US-Iran deal has left Israel isolated, with Netanyahu's Middle East strategy exposed. Global oil reserves, production, and consumption patterns are also changing, with a -2.22% change from last week and -13.10% from last year, according to the Energy Information Administration. Alternative energy sources are gaining attention, and the region's energy landscape is evolving. The pursuit of previously unrecovered oil is driving new investments, altering the regional energy balance and influencing global geopolitics. This shift is redefining the Middle East's energy landscape and its implications for global power dynamics.

stories.headline: No other headlines provided to select from
stories.summary: Scranton Mayor Paige Cognetti, who is running for Congress, appointed a criminal to the city's Human Relations Commission. The individual later committed crimes while serving on the commission. This development has raised concerns about the mayor's judgment and decision-making. As a congressional candidate, Cognetti's actions are under scrutiny. The appointment of a criminal to a city commission has sparked questions about the vetting process and the potential risks associated with such a decision. The incident highlights the importance of thorough background checks and careful consideration when making appointments to public positions. Cognetti's campaign has not commented on the matter, leaving many to wonder about the implications of this decision on her congressional bid. The city's residents are also affected by the commission's actions, making this a significant local issue.

stories.headline: No other headlines provided to select from
stories.summary: Google has started testing a new feature that rewrites headlines of published news articles using AI. This move has prompted sharp criticism. The feature is part of Google's search engine and aims to provide concise and fact-consistent titles. However, the use of AI to rewrite headlines has raised concerns. In related news, users have been experiencing issues with the Google News app and website, with some troubleshooting steps suggested, including refreshing the app, clearing browser cache and cookies, and updating to the latest version. Meanwhile, other news sources, such as the ABC News app, continue to provide international news and updates on top stories, offering users alternative options for staying informed. The development of AI-generated headlines is a growing trend in the news industry.

stories.headline: BJP's New Game: Political Engineering Ideology is dead; long live the numbers game that is being played with the sole intention of securing a two-third majority in the Lok Sabha for the NDA, observe
stories.summary: The BJP-led NDA is focusing on securing a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha to pass key bills, including the Delimitation Bill and the Women's Reservation Act. With the monsoon session approaching, the party is working to achieve this goal through political engineering and defections. Political ideology is taking a backseat as parties prioritize numbers over principles. The BJP has been elevating lesser-known leaders, and experts like Nilanjan Mukhopadhyay observe that this strategy is driven by the Modi-Shah dominance and tensions within the RSS. The trend of political defections is reshaping India's electoral map, with many leaders switching parties for opportunistic reasons rather than ideological alignment. This shift highlights the increasing importance of numerical strength over ideological commitment in Indian politics. The BJP's efforts to secure a two-thirds majority will be crucial in determining the passage of key legislation.

stories.headline: Congress Faces Internal Power Struggle as Party Leaders Clash Over Election Strategy
stories.summary: The Congress party is facing an internal power struggle, with leaders clashing over election strategy. BJP leaders have criticized the party for prioritizing internal battles over governance, particularly in Karnataka. Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge and senior leader Rahul Gandhi must make key decisions amidst the uncertainty. Ajay Maken is consulting leaders individually to determine ticket distribution in Haryana. Recent revelations have fueled speculation about internal dissent and a possible party split. The party is experiencing discord in several poll-bound states, including Assam and Kerala, with young MPs questioning Rahul Gandhi's disruption strategy. Internal strife is also present in Telangana, where the fight for influence and important posts is a major source of discontent. The party's leadership is under scrutiny, with the BJP seizing on the opportunity to attack the Congress's leadership uncertainty.

stories.headline: Government Announces Plans to Reform Electoral System and Increase Voter Transparency
stories.summary: The US government has announced plans to reform the electoral system, aiming to increase voter transparency. A sweeping elections reform bill was unveiled by House Republicans, mandating requirements such as presenting photo ID when voting and citizenship verification to register. President Donald Trump has called on Congress to pass the SAVE America Act to safeguard America's elections from illegal voting. An executive action was signed by Trump, overhauling elections and requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. The action also demands that all ballots be received by Election Day. The proposed changes would create additional hurdles for voters ahead of the midterm elections, with the reform process emphasizing careful legislation, public consultation, and parliamentary debate. The goal is to ensure effective electoral reform and maintain the integrity of the democratic process.

stories.headline: Opposition Parties Unite to Challenge NDA's Majority in Upcoming Parliamentary Session
stories.summary: The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) faces a challenge in passing constitutional amendment bills due to lacking a two-thirds majority in Parliament. With the Monsoon Session approaching, the Centre is reaching out to opposition parties to build consensus on key issues. Opposition parties are uniting to challenge the NDA's majority, potentially impacting the passage of bills such as the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill 2026. The NDA has 300 MPs, but needs a two-thirds majority to pass constitutional amendments. The opposition's unity and the Centre's outreach efforts may lead to crucial discussions and potential alliances, adding a new twist to national politics. The upcoming parliamentary session is expected to be significant, with opposition leaders gathering for INDIA bloc discussions to strategize their approach.

stories.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty Gain As Crude Prices Fall, Buying In Blue-chips
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty gained as crude prices fell, with the Sensex rising 302 points or 0.39% to 77,104.46 and the Nifty increasing 89 points or 0.37% to 24,101.95. The gains were driven by robust buying in blue-chip stocks such as Reliance Industries and ICICI Bank. The drop in crude oil prices also contributed to the uptrend. The BSE Auto index rose 0.7%, with MRF, Hyundai India, and Tata Motors among the top gainers. The rally follows a strong performance on Wall Street, where major indices rose despite the Federal Reserve's hawkish tone, and easing geopolitical tensions after a US-Iran peace deal and a ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah. The Nifty IT index recovered from a 6% fall, while the NSE filed its IPO DRHP, leading to gains in NIACL and IFCI.

stories.headline: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
stories.summary: Indian markets ended the week on a flat note with a mild negative bias, as investors booked profits near record highs. The Sensex and Nifty had surged 2% earlier, adding Rs 10 lakh crore in market value, driven by easing US-Iran tensions and softer crude prices. However, on Friday, the Nifty 50 rose for an eighth consecutive session, supported by softer US labor data and potential Fed rate cuts. Financial stocks led the gains, while pharma and healthcare weakness capped the rise. Analysts expect momentum to continue, with geopolitical developments and oil prices remaining key triggers. The market is awaiting a decisive breakout above 23,800 for further upward momentum or a fall towards 23,600. Domestic buying interest was seen in select stocks, including JBM Auto and Hindustan Copper, amid mixed global market trends.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty gain amid lower crude prices, favourable global cues; What investors should note
stories.summary: Indian stock market benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty gained over 1% in early trade, driven by lower crude oil prices and favourable global cues. The decline in oil prices and easing US-Iran tensions lifted sentiment, with the Sensex surging as much as 1.35% or 1,000 points. Fresh foreign fund inflows and buying in blue-chip stocks also supported the rally. Reports that US President Donald Trump had cancelled plans to strike Iran, citing progress in talks, added to the positive momentum. The gains were led by stocks such as L&T and IndiGo, contributing to the overall optimism in the market. A firmer rupee and hopes of stronger earnings also supported the risk-on mood, leading to a sharp increase in the Indian equity markets. The market's positive trend was driven by a combination of domestic and global factors.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today Live, June 22: Stock to buy today: Godfrey Phillips India (₹2,281.25) Sensex Today, Nifty 50
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is trading positively, with the Nifty50 at 24,151.65, up 139 points or 0.58%, and the BSE Sensex at 77,249.66, up 447 points or 0.58%. Market sentiment appears broadly positive, with buying visible across most sectors. Technology and oil & gas are leading the gains, while financials remain mixed with selective participation. Godfrey Phillips India stock is recommended to buy at ₹2,281.25, with an accumulation target at ₹2,200 and a target price of ₹2,600, and a stop-loss at ₹2,100. The stock is listed on the BSE and NSE, with the codes 500163 and GODFRYPHLP, respectively. The overall market trend indicates a positive outlook, with most sectors experiencing gains.

stories.headline: Is the era of the POS operator coming to an end? Step outside your home in Lagos, Kano, or Port Harcourt, and walk 20 metres. Under a frayed umbrella, seated on a plastic chair with a small banner, you will
stories.summary: In major Nigerian cities like Lagos, Kano, and Port Harcourt, Point of Sale (POS) operators are a common sight, providing cash withdrawal services under umbrellas with card readers and backpacks full of cash. These operators have been the backbone of Nigeria's cash-dependent economy, serving millions. However, their era of making a comfortable living is rapidly coming to an end. The POS ecosystem is evolving, with the traditional model of operating under an umbrella with a plastic card reader no longer sustainable. The industry is growing up, with changes likely to impact the livelihoods of these grassroots financial service providers. As the Nigerian economy adapts to new financial technologies and regulations, the role of POS operators is expected to transform, potentially disrupting their businesses and forcing them to innovate to remain relevant. This shift may have significant implications for financial access in Nigeria.

stories.headline: Michael Saylor Claims Strategy Added 716,000 BTC Since 2022 Balance Sheet Stress Michael Saylor has returned to one of the most dramatic periods in Strategy’s Bitcoin bet, contrasting the company’s 2022 balance sheet stress with what he says
stories.summary: Michael Saylor stated that Strategy has added over 716,000 BTC to its holdings since 2022, a period marked by balance sheet stress. The company has raised over $60 billion in additional capital, which was invested in Bitcoin. As a result, Strategy's Bitcoin reserves now total 846,842 BTC, valued at approximately $53.83 billion. The company's total reserves, including USD, exceed its debt by around $48 billion. Strategy's current debt stands at $6.75 billion, with $1.1 billion in USD reserves and $15.48 billion in preferred equity. At the time of Saylor's remarks, the company's market capitalization was roughly $40.1 billion, with its stock trading near $112.53. The significant increase in Bitcoin holdings has shifted the company's balance sheet, improving its financial position.

stories.headline: Saylor Defends Strategy Amid STRC Price Drop and Fraud Claims Key Insights:Saylor said Strategy’s Bitcoin and cash reserves exceed its outstanding debt by about $48 billion.STRC fell below its $100 par value, sparking crit
stories.summary: Michael Saylor defended Strategy's Bitcoin strategy as its preferred stock, STRC, fell below its $100 par value. According to Saylor, Strategy's Bitcoin and cash reserves exceed its outstanding debt by approximately $48 billion. This statement aims to reassure investors about the company's financial health. However, critics have raised concerns, with some likening STRC to a "classic centralized Ponzi." The drop below par value has sparked criticism and dividend pressure. Despite this, Saylor insists that Strategy has a margin of safety due to its significant reserves. The company's debt was previously reported to exceed the value of its Bitcoin and cash by about $300 million, but Saylor's update suggests a substantial buffer. STRC's performance has raised questions about the sustainability of Strategy's Bitcoin-backed funding model.

stories.headline: FULL LIST: Top 10 platforms Nigerians use to find foreign remote jobs in 2026 The Nation Newspaper FULL LIST: Top 10 platforms Nigerians use to find foreign remote jobs in 2026
stories.summary: Nigerians are utilizing various platforms to find foreign remote jobs in 2026. The top 10 platforms include Remote.co, which focuses exclusively on remote work opportunities from companies with a remote work culture. Other platforms include Remotive, FlexJobs, and Truly Remote, which offer access to remote jobs that hire worldwide, updated daily. These platforms provide features such as unlimited job listings, articles, and webinars to aid in the job search. Some platforms, like Truly Remote, only work with employers offering 100% work-from-home jobs. With thousands of remote jobs updated daily, these platforms cater to digital nomads and remote workers seeking full-time, part-time, or contract roles. The list highlights the growing demand for remote work opportunities among Nigerians, with various platforms available to facilitate their job search. These platforms are updated regularly, with some featuring over 30,000 remote jobs.

stories.headline: Google’s Nobel-Winning AI Expert Departing for Anthropic
stories.summary: Nobel Prize-winning researcher John Jumper is leaving Google DeepMind after nearly nine years to join AI startup Anthropic. Jumper, a co-creator of AlphaFold, announced his departure on June 19, 2026. His move marks a significant talent loss for Google, following the recent departure of Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer to OpenAI. Jumper's exit is part of a wave of high-profile AI talent exits from Google, highlighting the intense competition for elite AI researchers. As a vice president and senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, Jumper's work on AlphaFold earned him a Nobel Prize. His decision to join Anthropic is a notable gain for the AI startup, and a loss for Google's AI research division. Jumper's departure underscores the challenges Google faces in retaining top AI talent.

stories.headline: Anthropic, OpenAI PACs Pour $37 Million Into 2026 Midterm
stories.summary: Two networks of super PACs tied to artificial intelligence rivals Anthropic and OpenAI have spent over $37 million on 2026 congressional primaries. The spending is led by OpenAI-linked Think Big PAC and American Mission, alongside Anthropic-affiliated Jobs and Democracy and Defending Our Values. This investment makes them among the biggest outside spenders in the cycle, as the AI industry seeks to influence who writes the rules for AI in Washington. The financial contributions span both parties and various races, with a notable focus on New York's congressional primaries. According to Federal Election Commission filings, this significant spending indicates an aggressive push by the AI industry to shape AI governance, with Anthropic and OpenAI engaging in a proxy war through their backed super PACs.

stories.headline: AI sets odds of XRP trading at $20 by 2030
stories.summary: XRP's price is predicted to potentially reach $20 by 2030, according to AI projections. Currently, XRP is trading at $1.14, down 0.6% over the past 24 hours, with a modest weekly gain of 0.2%. The AI prediction gives XRP a 25% chance of trading below $5 by 2030, a 40% probability of landing between $5 and $12, and a 20% chance of reaching between $12 and $20. A short-term prediction for the end of 2025 sets XRP's price at $5, driven by speculation of a spot XRP ETF. Long-term fundamentals, including potential use as a global bridge asset for central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, support the $20 prediction by 2030. The cryptocurrency faces near-term weakness, with the token at risk of falling below the key $1 support level.
